class T {
  private static final Map<String, String> SLOT_TO_TRIGGER = new HashMap<String, String>();
  private static final Map<String, String> XHR = new HashMap<String, String>();
  static { XHR.put("X-Requested-With", "XMLHttpRequest"); }

  static
  {
    SLOT_TO_TRIGGER.put("ampCompresor1",  "amperaje.compresorS1");
    SLOT_TO_TRIGGER.put("ampCompresor2",  "amperaje.compresorS2");
  }
  static String trigger(String slot) { return SLOT_TO_TRIGGER.get(slot); }
}
